name: lm3s2965
description: TI Stellaris LM3S2965 (Cortex-M3 up to 50 MHz, 256 KB flash, 64 KB SRAM, 2 CAN, 3 UART, 2 I2C, SSI, 4 GPTM, 6-output PWM with dead band and fault, QEI, 10-bit ADC with 4 sequencers, 3 comparators, hibernation module, watchdog). Board: EK-LM3S2965 (128x96 OLED, CAN device board with an LM3S2110).

toolchain.notes: Board examples build with their own makefile; tools/stellaris/build_stellaris.py in the Renode tree builds them (patched linker scripts) and examples/peripherals programs (startup_lm3s.c, pin-multiplexer names as no-ops). Flash at 0, SRAM at 0x20000000: the linker script of any board example (e.g. boards/ek-lm3s2965/hello/hello.ld) fits.

image.notes: load the ELF; the vector table is at 0 (InitVectorTableOffset 0, also for a boot loader that runs from SRAM)

renode.notes: Board: platforms/boards/ti/ek-lm3s2965.repl (OLED = ssi0.oled, an SSD1329 with D/C on PC7; LED PG2 = gpioPortG.led; select button PG4 = gpioPortG.select; console uart0). CAN device board: platforms/boards/ti/ek-lm3s2965-can-device.repl (LM3S2110; LED PF2, up / down buttons PF0 / PF1); put both machines' can0 on one CAN hub. Models in Peripherals/Stellaris. Pins: 'sysbus.gpioPortB OnGPIO 3 false' drives PB3; input 8+n of a port is the peripheral function of pin n; open-drain pins release the line when driven high. 'sysbus.sysctl SystemClock' gives the clock; 'sysbus.adc SetInputVoltage 0 1.5' and 'sysbus.adc Temperature 30' set what the ADC measures; 'sysbus.qei0 Rotate 100' turns the encoder; 'sysbus.ssi0.oled LoadFont @<StellarisWare>/boards/ek-lm3s2965/drivers/rit128x96x4.c' then 'sysbus.ssi0.oled Text 0 24 20' reads text back from the panel, 'LitPixels' counts lit pixels. Flash programming goes through the flash controller (FMA/FMD/FMC); CPU stores to flash are ignored. CAN runs on a fixed 8 MHz clock and sends at the configured bit rate. Docs: tools/stellaris/README.md (36 checks pass).

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with the StellarisWare EK-LM3S2965 board examples (incl. boot loader, CAN with the device board, quickstart game) and examples/peripherals (tools/stellaris/run_stellaris_examples.py with examples_ek-lm3s2965.txt in the Renode tree)
